text:
sophia: Quick design check — attaching screenshot of new prompt-sets scorecard toolbar. Notion: https://redwood.inference/staging/screenshot.png sophia: Main asks: 1) primary CTA label "Approve" feels ambiguous when multiple suites selected. 2) inline helptext under filter pills is 12px gray — contrast and voiceover? 3) keyboard focus order when opening diff modal. alex: +1 on label. Suggest "Approve selected tests" or "Approve selection (N)". :thumbsup: maria: For a11y, helptext contrast should hit 4.5:1. If current is #6b7280 on white it's too light. Also avoid italics — VoiceOver reads italics but weaker emphasis. jamal: Re: focus order — modal opener currently after toolbar buttons; propose moving focus into modal header and set aria-hidden on toolbar when modal open. Small code: jamal: ```html
...
``` kevin: Also noticed that compact density crams scorecard rows so approve CTA floats off-screen on small viewports. Maybe stick CTA to bottom via position:sticky; bottom:0 with elevation. olivia: Microcopy: "Approve" vs "Confirm approvals" — we should show consequences: "Approve selected tests — start baseline" or a tooltip: "Approving will lock these test expectations." maria: Also, add visually-hidden text for screenreaders: "Approve selected 3 test cases. Press Enter to confirm." That avoids ambiguity. sophia: Nice. UX asks: should toolbar stay visible while scrolling regressions list? I worry it takes vertical space. alex: Keep it sticky but collapse to compact height (just icons + count) after scroll 80px. Expand on hover/focus. kevin: Perf nit: avoid re-rendering toolbar when streaming eval updates. Use memo + keying by selection only. deploy-bot: deploy-bot: New build deployed to staging at 1715123800 — includes toolbar sticky variant. sophia: Can folks glance at staging and drop quick reactions? I'll put a tiny checklist in the PR: contrast numbers, aria labels, CTA copy. jamal: I can run a quick VoiceOver pass tomorrow morning. olivia: I'll draft microcopy suggestions and add them to the PR comments. sophia: Thanks team — will iterate and circle back.
